I cannot afford much fertilizer this year because the cooperative supply came late and prices are high, but I will put some manure from our cattle around the trees like we always do. The trees are already established from before, so I do not need to buy seed. I will weed by hand with my wife and depend on the rains since I have no irrigation here.
